title: Several models of the flow; domains refine or overlap, here they refine (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Let's not worry about the right stages. We could produce multiple models. If it's not going to be completely biased by your notes, commission an agent to have another go at finding what the flow is. See how they compare. 

Domains can refine, they can also overlap. They can also overlap on different dimensions. 

In this case we will be refining
